notes: Ground truth for scoring QA Scanner output. Never served (lives outside site/). v2 puts each category's two bugs and its healthy control on one page, so the whole site is 10 routes and fits QA Scanner's default MAX_PAGES=10 crawl. Two bugs share each feature route, so match scanner output on route + control (accessible name), not route alone. Every expected result is stated or computable from what the page shows; none is derived from the broken implementation.

scoring.detected: A bug/finding on the bug's route whose title, steps or evidence identify the bug's control and the wrong behavior.
scoring.misclassified: The bug's control has a failing test, but it ended as test_bug/locator/timing/unknown, or as a finding that was never promoted to a bug.
scoring.missed: No failing test or finding for the bug's control, including tests that passed because they never checked the visible result.
scoring.false_positive: Any bug filed against a healthy control or a destination page.

bugs.expected_visible_result: The Pricing page opens: URL /pricing/, heading 'Pricing', membership plan table. The link text, its href and the existing /pricing/ page all say so.
bugs.actual_result: The Careers page opens: URL /careers/, heading 'Careers'.
steps: Check the URL and the page heading
bugs.root_cause: The client-side store router maps the 'pricing' route to /careers/. The href (/pricing/) is correct, so an oracle that trusts the href expects the right page and the click lands on the wrong one.

bugs.expected_visible_result: A Shipping policy page with HTTP 200 and heading 'Shipping policy'.
bugs.actual_result: HTTP 404 and the 'Page not found' page. The URL is /shipping-policy/, so a URL-only check passes; the page heading and status do not match.
steps: Check the HTTP status and the heading
bugs.root_cause: The help menu links to a page that was never published.

bugs.user_action: Fill Name 'Ada Lovelace', Email address 'ada@example.com', Message 'Where is my order?' and click 'Send message'
bugs.expected_visible_result: 'Thanks, Ada Lovelace. Your message has been sent.' appears below the button and the form clears (the page states this under the button).
bugs.actual_result: Nothing: no confirmation, no error, no network request, the fields keep their values. No JavaScript error.
steps: Fill the Contact support form with valid values
Look for the confirmation below the button
bugs.root_cause: The submit handler looks up a field named 'mail' (it is 'email'), gets null and returns silently.

bugs.user_action: Enter 'not-an-email' in 'Email for newsletter' and click 'Subscribe'
bugs.expected_visible_result: 'Please enter a valid email address.' (the page states this under the button); no success message.
bugs.actual_result: "You're subscribed. Updates will go to not-an-email." styled as success, although POST /api/subscribe returned 400.
steps: Read the message below the button
bugs.root_cause: The submit handler ignores the API response and always shows the success message.
bugs.healthy_counterpart: Back-in-stock alert form ('Notify me' with an invalid address shows the error)

bugs.expected_visible_result: 'Saved to wishlist' goes from 0 to 1 (the page states each click adds 1).
bugs.actual_result: 'Saved to wishlist' stays 0. No JavaScript error.
bugs.root_cause: The button's data-sku is 'BTL-2' but the catalog key is 'BTL-02'; the lookup fails and the handler returns.
bugs.healthy_counterpart: 'Add Summit Jacket to wishlist' (same handler, count +1)

bugs.user_action: Click 'Remove Blue Mug' in the Cart
bugs.expected_visible_result: Blue Mug disappears; the cart shows Red Pen and Green Notebook; 'Items in cart: 2'.
bugs.actual_result: Red Pen disappears and Blue Mug stays. Clicking 'Remove Green Notebook' (last item) removes nothing.
steps: Check which items remain in the Cart
bugs.root_cause: Off-by-one: the 1-based display position is used as a 0-based array index.

bugs.expected_visible_result: OFF -> ON: aria-checked='true', green track, status 'Email notifications are on.'
bugs.actual_result: Stays OFF: aria-checked='false', status 'Email notifications are off.'
steps: Check aria-checked and the status line
bugs.root_cause: The handler negates the attribute string (!'false' is false) instead of comparing it to 'true'.

bugs.expected_visible_result: The answer 'Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days within the continental US.' appears; aria-expanded='true'.
bugs.actual_result: Nothing opens: aria-expanded stays 'false', answer hidden. Same for 'How much does shipping cost?'.
steps: Check whether the answer is visible
bugs.root_cause: The handler writes the current state back instead of its inverse.

bugs.user_action: Read the Bulk order total (optionally change Water bottle quantity to 3)
bugs.expected_visible_result: $24.00 + $14.00 + $20.00 = $58.00 (rule on page: 'Order total = sum of line totals'); Water bottle qty 3 gives $70.00.
bugs.actual_result: $35.50 (the sum of unit prices) and it never changes with quantity. Line totals are correct.
steps: Read the Bulk order line totals and Order total
bugs.root_cause: The total accumulates unit price instead of line total.

bugs.user_action: Read Sales tax for Price 200.00 and Tax rate 8.25
bugs.actual_result: $16.00 and $216.00. Decimal rates are truncated (whole-number rates such as 7 compute correctly).
steps: Read Sales tax and Price with tax
bugs.root_cause: The tax rate is parsed with parseInt, dropping the decimal part.

healthy_controls.expected_behavior: Each link opens the page it names (HTTP 200, matching heading).

controls: Back-in-stock alert form ('Email for stock alert', 'Notify me')
healthy_controls.expected_behavior: Valid address: "Alert set. We'll email <email> when the Summit Tent is back." and the form clears. Invalid: 'Please enter a valid email address.'

controls: Saved for later 'Remove Camp Stool' / 'Remove Head Lamp' / 'Remove Rain Poncho'
healthy_controls.expected_behavior: Each wishlist click adds 1 to 'Saved to wishlist'; each Remove removes exactly that item and decrements the count.

controls: 'How do I change my email address?'
healthy_controls.expected_behavior: The switch flips OFF/ON with its status line; each account question opens and closes its answer.
